title: CDS Hooks Request-Response Cycle
description: Trace a warfarin drug-interaction alert and a diabetes care-gap alert through the identical six-step CDS Hooks cycle, reading the literal JSON at each boundary.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: CDS Hooks
clinical decision support
FHIR
interoperability
clinical alerting

educational.audience: Undergraduate students and healthcare data practitioners
learningObjectives: Given a clinical scenario, the learner can examine which CDS Hooks hook type would fire and differentiate the roles of context, prefetch, and the returned card in producing a correctly timed alert.
